text:
Tara V.: hi @people-ops — quick heads up. i've been diagnosed with an episodic seizure disorder and my neurologist advised against overnight shifts and long oncall windows for the next few months while meds are adjusted. can we arrange a temporary oncall restriction (no nights, no more than one 4-hour block/day) and document as an accommodation? i can DM a redacted provider note or use the secure form.
Evan G. (Manager): thanks for telling us, Tara. we can cover nights and shorten your oncall blocks. will coordinate with the team and ppl ops to make it official. please DM Carla with the note or point me to the form.
Carla (People Ops): hi Tara 1 thanks for flagging and sorry to hear you're dealing with this. please submit a brief functional note via the confidential accommodations form (https://intranet.redwood/hr/accom-form) or DM me the receipt. we will open a case and propose a temporary plan (default 60-90 day review).
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2055-777 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Tara V.: uploaded a redacted note and DM'd Carla the confirmation. thanks. for coverage, i can trade weekday day-blocks but not nights. also asking for notification protocol if there's an urgent pager so team knows how to escalate.
Evan G. (Manager): team: i can take two of Tara's night blocks for the next 8 weeks and we'll redistribute remaining nights across volunteers. we'll also set a "urgent" escalation path that routes to me first before paging Tara.
Carla (People Ops): summary of next steps:
1) People Ops documents AC-2055-777 and notifies Manager + SRE rota leads
2) Manager updates rota and marks Tara as "no overnight duty" (timeboxed; review in 60 days)
3) People Ops drafts an accommodation note to share with required teams (no medical specifics) e.g., "temporary restriction on overnight shifts due to health; see private manager note for context"
4) If needed, People Ops may request an occupational health confirmation; we often accept a redacted provider note to verify functional limits
5) Legal will review any adverse action language if performance or escalation decisions overlap with accommodation status

Legal Counsel: quick note 1 ensure staffing adjustments are documented and timeboxed; avoid permanent reassignments without consent. if there's a need for longer-term work modification, we'll coordinate a formal interactive process.
peopleops-bot: AC-2055-777 status changed: intake -> documented.
Tara V.: appreciate the quick help. would also like a short private checklist for oncall coverage handoffs so i can step out if needed during episodes without leaving teammates undersupported.
Evan G. (Manager): good idea. i'll draft a 5-point handoff checklist (open incidents, primary contacts, short notes) and pin it to the oncall rota. will cc Carla so it becomes part of the accommodation doc.
Carla (People Ops): got the note and checklist will be included in AC-2055-777. we'll schedule a 30-day check-in to confirm the plan is working and adjust if needed. all health info here is confidential; please avoid sharing beyond necessary parties.
Tara V.: thank you all. feeling much better knowing there's a plan. :heart:
